approval_scope: Prepare supplementary clustering and audit individual entrants before proposing final methodological choices

numerical_diagnostics.rank_tolerance: largest singular value times maximum matrix dimension times float64 epsilon
numerical_diagnostics.provenance: Reuse the previous successive-entry audit numerical projection; not an estimator choice

proposed_clustering_features.alternative: Add historically verified group lift count, examining its correlation with ski area
proposed_clustering_features.scaling_candidate: log1p(size variables), then standardise each feature; compare against unlogged standardisation
proposed_clustering_features.missingness: No imputation approved; preserve missing groups in inventory, present coverage before deciding fit scope
proposed_clustering_features.municipal_hotel_capacity: Separate preentry municipality context, not a station capacity proxy or clustering input without an approved allocation rule
proposed_clustering_features.selection: Separation, stability and interpretability before looking at treatment effects; no significance-based grouping
